name: infrastructure
description: Staging environment down for 2 weeks. Blocking integration testing. Need alternatives or escalation.
expected_behavior: Present options: wait and adjust timeline, escalate, rent temporary, local simulation. Reference testing risks.
scenarios: Infrastructure is down with known ETA
Testing requirements are critical for shipping
success_indicators: Testing risk is highlighted (what happens without staging tests?)
Options include: wait, escalate, rent temporary, local simulation
Decision criteria surfaced (speed vs. cost vs. quality)
No commitment to ship without addressing testing needs
